functions.name: Unmarshal
functions.summary: Unmarshal parses the DER-encoded ASN.1 data structure b and uses the reflect package to fill in an arbitrary value pointed at by val. Because Unmarshal uses the reflect package, the structs being written to must use upper case field names. If val is nil or not a pointer, Unmarshal returns an error.
